name: feature-highlights
title: Feature Highlight Cards
blurb: Dark 3-column highlight grid with icon, title, and learn-more link.
description: Three feature cards with icons, titles, descriptions, and call-to-action links on a dark background. Cards have hover background and border effects.
use_when: Feature highlight sections where dark backgrounds and icon-led design draw focus to key benefits.
avoid_when: Contrast-sensitive interfaces where dark cards with subtle text may fail accessibility standards.
a11y: Cards have semantic text hierarchy; CTA links are keyboard accessible. Hover background changes are visual feedback.
